title: Device limit is bypassed on every request after the first rejection
description: tagDeviceUI writes cache entry before store call, so ErrDeviceLimitReached results in the device being cached. First request from over-limit device gets 401; subsequent requests hit cache short-circuit and authenticate normally without ever being written to anon_device, never counting toward limit.

title: Store is no longer injectable; wire registration is now dead and unbuildable
description: ProvideAnonymousDeviceService now constructs anonstore.ProvideAnonDBStore internally instead of receiving anonstore.AnonStore, but pkg/server/wire.go still registers it. New deviceLimit int64 parameter has no provider in the graph, causing wire to fail when anything asks for anonstore.AnonStore.

title: New `device_limit` ini option is undocumented
description: PR checklist requires configuration changes to update conf/defaults.ini, conf/sample.ini, and configuration docs. None were touched. Operators have no way to discover the limit exists or that 0 means unlimited.

title: `anonymousDeviceLimit` is typed `undefined`, not `number | undefined`
description: Un-annotated class field initialized to undefined infers type `undefined` under strict mode. Consumers writing `config.anonymousDeviceLimit > 0` get type errors, though getFrontendSettings always sends an int64.
